answer: A payout is split so that 32% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The terrace schedule is applied in falcon and zenith shows each instalment. Someone hence cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3823 identities would post 2460 proofs and burn roughly 15 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
